# template name: # Ochsner GMWW (OTE3 controller) TEM protocol templates for ebusd
# Verified on a GMWW 10 with OTE3 SW 5.98 against the controller display (2026-10).
# NOTE: no commas inside the comment column - ebusd splits on every comma.
# Response layout: [TEM header][value]. Header byte 2 = type: 0x0d = 1 decimal (divide by 10)
#   0x04/0x00/0x01 = integer - 0x09 = selection - 0x4d/0x8d = setting (/10) - 0x1d = 4 byte HCD counter.
# See docs/ochsner_tem_protocol.md for the full decoding description.

comment: TEM response header 8 bytes (param no + type + unit + 2x 2 bytes) - ignored
TEM header 6 bytes - used for type 0x1d counters (value = 4 byte HCD)
temperature with one decimal (type 0x0d)
temperature integer signed 1 byte (e.g. 43 = 43 C)
flow temp at design outdoor temp - raw value / 2 (61 = 30.5 C - verified on display)
design outdoor temperature signed 1 byte (0xEE = -18 C)
pump off/on
percent 0-100 (1 byte)
percent 0-100 (2 bytes)
heating circuit status (23 = active heating - seen on SW 5.98)
heat pump status
hot water status (8 = demand reload below hysteresis - derived from data)
heat pump operating mode (1 = Automatik - verified on display)
hot water operating mode (1 = Automatik - verified on display)
heating circuit operating mode 03-050 (codes verified on display - 2/3/6 not offered)
volume flow l/min (raw / 10)
energy below 1 MWh - raw value in 0.1 kWh (type 0x0d)
energy MWh part
heat output kW (raw / 10 - value -100.0 = not available)
operating hours - 4 byte HCD with 2 decimals (use with param6)
switching cycles - 4 byte HCD (use with param6)
